The [[Aratech Repulsor Company/Legends|Aratech]] '''74-Zb''' was a modified version of the [[74-Z speeder bike/Legends|74-Z Speeder Bike]]. It was equipped with a heavier [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannon]] than the baseline model. A number of them were stored in the garage of [[Whisper Base]] in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]].
